annotation.title_clean: Land Transport and Related Matters (No. 2) Bill
annotation.title_en: Land Transport and Related Matters (No. 2) Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Parliament of Singapore (Ministry of Transport / Land Transport Authority)
annotation.summary_en: Singapore bill amending the Active Mobility Act, Electric Vehicles Charging Act, Road Traffic Act and Small Motorised Vehicles (Safety) Act. Among mainly personal-mobility, EV-charger and vehicle-disposal measures, it creates a framework for approved trials, special uses and testbeds of autonomous motor vehicles on public paths, with insurance, data recording and enforcement.
key_provisions_or_claims: New Division 2C of Active Mobility Act defines autonomous motor vehicles and regulates approved trials, special uses and testbeds on public paths
Minister may require liability insurance, publicity notices, vehicle registers, sensor data/video recording and manual-takeover alert systems
Authority may grant conditional authorisations, exempt from traffic rules, and suspend or cancel them; appeal to Minister
Offence for interfering with autonomous vehicle trials or equipment (fine up to $5,000); AV regulations sunset 30 September 2031
Tougher penalties for unsafe PABs/PMDs, non-compatible batteries, misleading advertising and online-marketplace directions
